name: mapping-constructor-expr-test-833706cb84/mapping-constructor-infer-record-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: Mapping constructor — Currently [spread-field](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#spread-field) not supported
Expressions: Query expressions — Supports `from`, `where`, `let`, `join` (including outer join), `order by`, `limit`, `on conflict` and `select` clauses
reason: The case asserts inferred record assignment rejection after combining record spread fields. Mapping-constructor spread fields are explicitly unsupported, so the whole case requires a feature even though its query-based and other mapping inference rejection checks use supported constructs.
test_design_notes: Negative @error assertions exercise static rejection; their illegality alone does not place them outside the subset. The spread-based inference assertion is sufficient for the whole-case feature classification.
